issues.detail: The Greek word 'ανεκτοτερον' (anektoteron) means 'more tolerable' or 'more lightly' in the sense of judgment. The Vietnamese translation uses 'khoan dung hơn', which translates to 'more merciful' or 'more tolerant'. In the context of judgment, the Greek implies they will receive a lighter/less severe punishment, not that God will be more merciful toward them than toward the listeners.
